messages.subject: [FLR-list] problem with retrospective
messages.body_plain:
Dar all,
I'm having a problem running the retrospective analysis.
I'm using the sam model and previously I had a problem also with this,
that was solved adding the directory to the FLSAM function (ANCHOVY.sam <-
FLSAM(ANCHOVY,ANCHOVY.tun,ANCHOVY.ctrl, run.dir="c:\\samtemp\\")).

Now I have a new problem with the retrospective. It gives me this error:
 "Error in update.default(base.assess, Stock, Indices.temp, run.dir =
tempdir()) :
  need an object with call component
In addition: Warning messages:
1: running command './sam.exe -nr 2 -noinit -iprint 5' had status 1  2: In
retro(ANCHOVYrun6, ANCHOVY.tun, ANCHOVY.ctrl, retro = 1) :
  Retrospective for year 2014 failed"

Someone can help me to solve this problem?
Thank you so much.
Silvia
